description: Meaning-based (vector) search over the Ortexo database of Romanian law — codes, laws, the Fiscal Code (tax and VAT/TVA), accounting norms (OMFP) and, when requested, case law. Returns the current, in-force text with a citation for each result, one result per article. Best when the query describes a concept or situation rather than exact wording; for a known term or figure use search_lexical. For court decisions set `sources` to ["jurisprudence"] (with both corpora the results are ranked together and may all be legislation) — relevant to disputes, deductibility challenges, penalties, and whether a court has already decided a point, since Romanian case law on the same facts is persuasive. Accounting questions (OMFP, chart of accounts) are answered from this corpus, not by lookup_article.

sources.description: Corpora to search. Defaults to ["legislation"]. For Romanian case law (court decisions) use ["jurisprudence"]: with both corpora the results are ranked together and may all be legislation.

name: search_semantic
